propositions: The review bot fetches a tree using patchSet.ref but casts votes against patchSet.revision, which can be decoupled if the clone or fetch is stale or partial
After fetch and checkout, FETCH_HEAD must be asserted equal to patchSet.revision to ensure the reviewed tree matches the voted revision
adapter.py's ref parameter is currently unread and should perform the revision assertion instead of being ignored
A mismatch between resolved FETCH_HEAD and patchSet.revision must refuse to vote with a fail-closed, actionable error message
